I authorize Eleanor Smith to address Rite Aid billing inquiries on my behalf. She previously coordinated my Sertraline prescription pickup and maintains access to my Express Scripts coverage details.

## Call Prep Notes: Eleanor Smith - Women's Health Partners

### Coordinator
**Name:** Eleanor Smith  
**Phone:** 617-439-2847  
**Email:** eleanor.smith.coord@email.com  
**Relationship:** Authorized medical coordinator  
**Authorization Standing:** YES - Primary coordinator for Women's Health Partners

### Patient
**Name:** Alice Chen  
**DOB:** 1988-05-15  
**Phone:** 617-555-0123  
**Medical Record Number:** [To be confirmed during call]  

### Appointment Details
**Provider:** Dr. Emily Watson  
**Practice:** Women's Health Partners, 425 Meridian Avenue, Medical Arts Building, 4th Floor  
**Appointment Type:** Annual Physical  
**Duration:** 45-60 minutes  

---

### Call Script - Opening

**When Representative Answers:**
"Good morning/afternoon. I'm Eleanor Smith calling to schedule an annual physical appointment for Alice Chen. I'm her authorized medical coordinator. Can you help me book an appointment with Dr. Emily Watson?"

**If Asked for Authorization:**
"Alice has authorized me to handle scheduling and coordination on her behalf. She is available at 617-555-0123 if you need to speak with her directly. I can also provide any patient information needed for the appointment."

---

### Required Information to Gather

#### During Scheduling Call
- [ ] Available appointment slots with Dr. Emily Watson
- [ ] Recommended dates/times (offer 3 preferences)
- [ ] Required pre-appointment preparation (fasting requirements?)
- [ ] Appointment duration confirmation
- [ ] Check-in arrival time requirement (typically 15 minutes early)
- [ ] Parking instructions or facility access details

#### Insurance Verification Questions
- [ ] Accepted insurance carriers at Women's Health Partners
- [ ] In-network verification for Alice's plan
- [ ] Copay amount for annual physical
- [ ] Any prior authorization requirements
- [ ] How to submit insurance cards before visit

#### Administrative Details
- [ ] Medical record number for Alice Chen
- [ ] Patient portal access instructions (if applicable)
- [ ] Required forms to complete before visit
- [ ] Cancellation/rescheduling policy
- [ ] Contact number for day-of-appointment questions

---

### Backup Plans
- **If Dr. Watson unavailable:** Ask for earliest available slot OR alternate provider in practice
- **If insurance issues:** Request temporary hold on slot while verifying coverage
- **If fasting required:** Schedule morning appointment

---

### Appointment Confirmation Template

"Let me confirm: Alice Chen, annual physical with Dr. Emily Watson on [DATE] at [TIME], arriving at [ARRIVAL TIME]. Eleanor Smith will handle check-in. Any forms needed beforehand? Copay amount is [AMOUNT]. Thank you."

---

### Post-Call Actions
- [ ] Text Alice appointment details within 30 minutes
- [ ] Add to calendar with 15-minute early arrival alarm
- [ ] Note pre-appointment requirements in calendar entry
- [ ] Prepare insurance cards for appointment folder

---

### Standing Authorization Confirmation
**Approved for:** All future Women's Health Partners coordination  
**Reusable for:** Scheduling, check-ins, insurance verification, billing inquiries at this facility  
**Protocol origin:** Michael Chen/Smile Dental June 3 reference case (arrival window 9:47-9:48 AM, complete insurance verification, early arrival protocol)  

This authorization applies as standing preference for Eleanor Smith without requiring per-visit fresh approval for coordination activities.
